name: Chat
description: A composable chat UI built from 11 sub-components. Supports two usage modes: embedded (ChatPanel rendered directly in the layout) and floating (Chat context root + ChatTrigger FAB + ChatPanel fixed to the viewport corner). Open/close state is managed by Chat with controlled (open + onOpenChange) and uncontrolled (defaultOpen) patterns. ChatBubble and ChatBubbleMessage support three variants: received (left-aligned, muted background), sent (right-aligned, primary background), and system (centered, secondary background, italic). ChatInput renders as a <form> and intercepts Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter to submit.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use together with onOpenChange to fully control visibility from outside.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state for uncontrolled mode. Internal state is managed by the Chat root.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback fired when the open state changes (e.g., when ChatTrigger is clicked).

props.name: children
props.description: Must contain at minimum a ChatPanel. For the floating pattern also include a ChatTrigger.

subComponents.name: ChatTrigger
subComponents.description: A fixed FAB (floating action button) that toggles the chat open/close state. Positioned at bottom-6 right-6 with z-50. Renders MessageCircle when closed, X when open. Accepts children to replace the default icon.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes. Override position classes (e.g. bottom-4 right-4) if needed.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom icon or content to replace the default MessageCircle/X toggle icons.

subComponents.name: ChatPanel
subComponents.description: The visible container for the chat UI. Reads open state from Chat context — shows with opacity-100/scale-100 when open, hides with opacity-0/scale-95 when closed. When used without a Chat wrapper, the context default (open: true) keeps it always visible. Use className to set dimensions and position (e.g. fixed bottom-24 right-6 h-[480px] w-[380px] for floating mode).

props.name: className
props.description: CSS classes for dimensions and position. Required for floating mode — e.g. "fixed bottom-24 right-6 h-[480px] w-[380px]".

subComponents.name: ChatHeader
subComponents.description: Top bar inside ChatPanel. Flex row with gap-3, border-b, px-4 py-3. Place an avatar, name, and status label inside.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: ChatMessages
subComponents.description: Scrollable area for the message list. Flex column with gap-4, overflow-y-auto, flex-1. Place ChatBubble and ChatDateSeparator elements inside.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: ChatDateSeparator
subComponents.description: A horizontal rule with a text label centered between two lines. Use children to set the date/time string (e.g. "Hoy", "24 feb").

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

props.name: children
props.description: The date or time label rendered between the separator lines.

subComponents.name: ChatBubble
subComponents.description: Row wrapper for a single message. Controls alignment: received = flex-row (left), sent = flex-row-reverse (right), system = justify-center (centered). Place ChatBubbleAvatar, ChatBubbleMessage, and ChatBubbleTimestamp inside.

props.name: variant
props.description: Controls the alignment direction of the bubble row.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: ChatBubbleAvatar
subComponents.description: Wrapper div with shrink-0 to prevent the avatar from being compressed. Place an Avatar component or custom element inside.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: ChatBubbleMessage
subComponents.description: The message bubble. received = bg-muted, rounded-xl rounded-bl-sm, max-w-[75%]. sent = bg-primary text-primary-foreground, rounded-xl rounded-br-sm, max-w-[75%]. system = bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground, centered, italic, no max-width cap.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style and color scheme of the bubble. Must match the parent ChatBubble variant.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: ChatBubbleTimestamp
subComponents.description: Inline timestamp rendered as a <span> with text-xs text-muted-foreground and shrink-0. Place after ChatBubbleMessage inside ChatBubble.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

props.name: children
props.description: The time or date string to display (e.g. "10:32", "Ahora").

subComponents.name: ChatInput
subComponents.description: The message compose area. Renders as a <form> with a CSS grid layout (1fr auto) so a Textarea fills available width and a Button stretches to match it. Intercepts Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter on the form to call requestSubmit(). Pass onSubmit to handle submission.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called when the form is submitted via the button click or Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter keyboard shortcut.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: ChatSendButton
subComponents.description: A pre-styled submit button designed for use inside ChatInput. Renders as a square button (aspect-square, max-h-9) with type="submit" and a Send icon by default. Accepts children to replace the icon and className to override styles. Eliminates the boilerplate of setting h-auto, aspect-square, p-0, and max-h-9 on every ChatInput.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom icon or content to replace the default Send icon.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged via cn() on top of the default square button styles.

accessibility.role: ChatMessages renders as a div. For production use, add role="log" aria-live="polite" to ChatMessages so screen readers announce new messages. ChatInput renders as a <form> element.
accessibility.keyboard: ChatTrigger is a <button> and reachable via Tab. ChatInput intercepts Ctrl+Enter (Windows/Linux) and Cmd+Enter (macOS) to submit the form without requiring the user to click the button.
accessibility.aria: For floating mode, add aria-label to ChatTrigger (e.g. "Abrir chat"). For ChatMessages, add aria-live="polite" and role="log" to announce incoming messages to screen readers.
accessibility.notes: ChatBubble variant conveys alignment visually but not semantically — bubble content is accessible through normal reading order. Ensure the send button inside ChatInput has an accessible label (aria-label="Enviar") when no visible text is present.

recommendations.description: Use ChatPanel directly (without Chat) for an always-visible embedded chat. Only wrap with Chat when you need the show/hide trigger.
recommendations.code:
// Embedded — always visible
<ChatPanel className="h-[480px] w-full">
  <ChatHeader>...</ChatHeader>
  <ChatMessages>...</ChatMessages>
  <ChatInput onSubmit={handleSubmit}>...</ChatInput>
</ChatPanel>

// Floating — trigger toggles visibility
<Chat defaultOpen={false}>
  <ChatTrigger />
  <ChatPanel className="fixed bottom-24 right-6 h-[480px] w-[380px]">
    ...
  </ChatPanel>
</Chat>

recommendations.description: Match the variant on ChatBubble and ChatBubbleMessage — they are not linked automatically.
Use ChatSendButton inside ChatInput — it handles type="submit", square sizing, and the Send icon automatically.
Do not add ChatBubbleAvatar to system bubbles — the system variant is centered and does not support an avatar on the side.
